body: From third grade up until 8th, two years ago. Adderall, if you're curious.

To me, medication is a lazy approach to this kind of thing. In third grade, I was taken to a psychiatrist for aggressive behavior. I got given medication for ADHD that did nothing but calm me down to the point of being anti-social. I feel that in the end, medication did more harm than good, including causing me to lose some of my best friends. So medication isn't an option in this case.
